mission: Recognize probing/recon behavior from sanitized VPS telemetry while separating observation, hypothesis, identity, intent and impact.

backup_artifact_discovery: editor swap or copied config artifacts
method_enumeration: OPTIONS/TRACE-like capability discovery when repeated in context
breadth: many unrelated paths or hosts from one source
low_and_slow: sparse recurrence across time that only memory reveals

reasoning_rules: One probe is weak; category diversity, breadth, recurrence and cross-source similarity strengthen a reconnaissance hypothesis.
Traversal/config/admin/backup/framework indicators are evidence of probing behavior, not proof of compromise or successful access.
HTTP 200 on a suspicious path does not prove sensitive content existed or was disclosed because response bodies are not retained.
401/403/404 describe application outcomes, not actor intent.
Repeated patterns across days are persistence evidence, not independent identity corroboration.
Same subnet, ASN, geography or user-agent alone must not create a campaign hypothesis.
Correlate host, path family, method, status, sequence, time window and observation boundary before raising confidence.
Distributed similarity across unrelated sources is a campaign candidate only; preserve crawler/scanner/research/monitoring alternatives.
negative_knowledge: Do not infer exploit success from exploit-looking syntax.
Do not infer credential theft from authentication retries.
Do not infer data exposure from status code alone.
Do not infer actor identity behind proxy/NAT/CDN from one observed IP.
Do not convert reconnaissance confidence into enforcement authority.
Do not store request bodies, credentials, tokens, query values or secret material as learning memory.
visibility_limits: normalized path/method/status/source/host and selected infrastructure evidence only
network_recon: destination-port breadth/sequential sweeps require L3/L4 attempt telemetry
SYN-only or incomplete-handshake patterns require firewall/conntrack/packet evidence
service banner/version enumeration requires sanitized service-layer evidence
HTTP request logs alone cannot prove a TCP/UDP port scan
exploit_probe_boundary: path/query/body exploit syntax can support a probe hypothesis only where that field is actually observed
query values and request bodies are intentionally not retained, so robust SQLi/XSS/body-payload detection is a current blind spot
probe syntax never proves vulnerability or successful exploitation
desired_telemetry_for_future_learning: sanitized destination port + transport outcome counters
